nom: First Aid Beauty Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid +Ceramides

avis.texte: Bring back Oil Control moisturizer!!! This product does not work well with oily skin and feels gooey instead of absorbing into the skin. People with oily skin want a matte finish. The fact that this is recommended for Normal, Combination, and Oily skin says it all. One formula does not serve all!

avis.titre: Holy grail level moisture, make bigger size!!
avis.texte: This moisturizer is magic. Feels sooooo luxury but is affordable! My only complaint is that it doesn't come in a larger size with an air sealed pump delivery system. Pleaseeeee make a jumbo size of this. It's so amazing

I have oily skin and was looking for a daytime moisturizer. This left such a film on my skin and made me feel greasy. Sad because I love other products by this brand. I'll use it as an expensive body moisturizer ….

I have been searching for a face moisturizer that is noncomedogenic, safe for sensitive skin, deeply moisturizes without feeling heavy/greasy, and has both hyaluronic acid and ceramides - this checks every box!!! It feels rich but not too heavy, and it gives the perfect dewy finish - I often get compliments on how glowy my skin looks! Layers very well under makeup (no pilling, unlike some ceramide products). I have sensitive/reactive skin, so I use mostly unscented products, and this doesn't irritate my skin at all.
Bring back Oil Control moisturizer. That was too good of a moisturizer and this is just not it.

I have a lot of first aid beauty products so I decided to try this for a day time moisturizer and I love it! It absorbs into my dry skin pretty quickly and sits nicely beneath both my sunscreen and my make-up. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a nice day time moisturizer or even a night time one if you have more normal/combo skin and want a water-like moisturizer
I love first aid beauty, and wanted to try this. But it just didn't work for me. My face didn't like something in here.

avis.titre: Bring back Ultra Repair Oil Control Moisturizer!
avis.texte: I agree with the few people who are calling for the return of Ultra Repair Oil Control Moisturizer. It was the very first product that worked for my combination skin. What happened to it? Why was it discontinued?!

This is thr ONLY moisturizer I've found that doesn't make my skin break out. I've tried dozens of different moisturizers and this is the only one I've bought recently that doesn't break me out. I was using a neutrogena moisturizer until they changed the formula and added cica to it which my skin absolutely hates. I'm very grateful to have found this moisturizer!

This is good for oily skin possibly combo skin but if you are dry at all this wont help. I'm most put off by the smell, it smells like cat food at first. I also dont like dipping my fingers in the jar and find it not the most hygenic packaging. An air tight container is preferred especially for the price.
Perfect for combination, acne prone skin. I do wish the product went a little further (have to use a decent amount) but it works great for sensitive skin that is easily aggrevated.

i have combo skin and i really love how hydrating this is without being heavy or adding to my oiliness. a little goes a long way and it absorbs very nicely and leaves a soft supple feel. for the amount of product you get for the price i would say its worth it, it will last awhile.

I really loved this moisturizer! I needed something that wouldn't break me out but really hydrate my dry skin. This did both! But it doesnt last long at all, especiallt for the price. Their cream is double the size for the same price! So I will be finding something else.

My daughter has been using this on her acne prone skin for two months and has seen great results. We spent the last year looking for a moisturizer for her that would not case break outs and this is it! Her skin is perfectly hydrated and she says it feels amazing for the first time that she can remember! Repurchasing more today and would highly recommend!
It is very moisturizing. The one con is that to me it feels very heavy on my skin. I do think for non makeup up people that this is a very good moisturizer and worth the price.

While the oil control moisturizer has been "sold out" for months, I bought this thinking it was a repackaged version or something. While the texture is similar and light, it is more tacky and a little thicker than the oil control. By mid day, my face is shinier than a new car (and not in a good way). By end of day, the oil from my eyelids is running into my eyes. It did not make me breakout.. I just look oily. Not dewy, but almost drenched in glaze. I will have to shop elsewhere for my daily moisturizer if FAB does not bring back oil control, because this is NOT it for me and the coconut water one is not moisturizing enough. 34, female, acne prone, large pores, combination skin, oily T zone, sensitive skin, redness, dry patches

I changed up my face products when I started to have breakouts several months ago. This was highly rated in several online lists and I really like the product. It doesn't pill up under primer and foundation and it absorbs really well.

I've been using this for almost a year now. When I tell y'all I reach fo this OFTEN I mean it. When my skin is very dry and in need of a little TLC I reach for this. When I do a full skincare routine at night I reach for this. I live in Alabama so that can be often for me with the changing temps. But the selling point for me is when I became pregnant I had this awful dry cracked skin appear around my nose. It hurt and looked awful. I unfortunately had a miscarriage but the dry cracked skin stayed long after, it just wouldn't go away. I discovered this product after some deep searching and I saw change and felt relief within 2 days! Full transparency, since my skin was cracked around my nose upon initial use I did have a slight buring sensation but it did subside rather quickly and with future uses I did not feel this. I started with a small amount only around my nose before applying to entire face. But be warned that this may occur depending on how damaged your skin is when starting. It is very thick so you dont need much and does take a little time to dry down. So I personally only use it at night. If its a cold windy day and I'm not wearing any makeup i'll wear it during the day. But it works WONDERS! A little goes a long way. If you apply at night you can slug a little more with it and by the time you wake up in the morning you'll notice how soft and hydrated your skin feels. You'll also notice any dry skin beginning to heal. Upon first use I recommend giving yourself 4-7

I had such high hopes from the reviews, only to be let down. Here's how I got here, I love first aid beauty ultra repair cream, it is fantastic for hydrating snd calming my skin but it also leaves my skin a little too oily for my liking. So I tried the ultra repair cream with oil control as a solution but it wasn't helping hydrate my skin at all. After all the fabulous reviews, I thought I had finally found the answer, I was wrong. My rosacea is flaring horribly. My entire face looks red and vieny, and it's also slightly itchy. I havent changed anything else so it has to be this moisturizer. I just dont get how it works so well for everyone else but not me. Sad.

avis.titre: New favorite compared to Ultra Repair Cream
avis.texte: I've been a long time First Aid Beauty customer. Every November, I wait for Ulta to have a sale on the Ultra Repair Cream so I can stock up. This year, I decided to try this product and I'm so happy I did!!! While the Ultra Repair Cream was hydrating and helped with my body ezecma, it always felt so heavy on my skin. I have very dry skin but that moisturizer just left me feeling oily. I'm on day 3/4 of this product and I love it so much more. It feels me feel hydrated without feeling like I have so much product on my face. It applies nicely as well. I'm excited to keep using this product. I also have sensitive skin and haven't noticed any breakouts (yet… it's still very early to tell) however in terms of feeling and quality of product, this is 5/5 stars for me.
I love this moisturizer! It's so soft and keeps my skin clear and smoother. My only problem is the size. I would love if they created a big tub of this though, I would buy it in a heartbeat!

I typically NEVER write reviews about products but this mostuzier deserves so much recognition. Ive dealt with having a hard time finding good mosturizers for a decade now and spent countless $$ to find a good one, but when i stumbled upon this product wholy crap never going back to anything else but THIS. I am a person who had acne prone sensitive dry skin and this has done miracles. Ive looked for a mosturizer that my skin doesnt automatically suck up immediately and leave me looking "dry" this does the opposite and leaves that dewy look. Its so so so worth it for the price and honestly as someone who has also suffered with cystic acne from a young age i have seen a lot of improvement in my acne as well! It recovers your skin barrier FAST if anyone is suffering from that.

I absolutely LOVE this moisture for my extremely sensitive and reactive skin. After 20+ years searching for a moisturizer that doesn't break me out, I found the ONE!!! Please don't change a single thing about this product; it truly is the best product that First Aid Beauty has ever made!!!

Listen, I dont write reviews often but when I do— that's how you know it's real good. For reference: have extremely sensitive, dry, acne prone skin. And this product does not break me out, cause any irritation, and it actually gets the job done. Most gel moisturizers evaporate off my face within minutes but not this one!!

avis.titre: This is my new everyday moisturizer.
avis.texte: This moisturizer is light and not greasy. I use in the morning first thing before applying my makeup and at night before going to bed. I have sensitive skin so I appreciate the fact that it is not perfumy or has additives that are unnecessary.
The best moisturizer I have ever tried for combo oily skin. My face, neck, and chest is so soft. No pore clogging ingredients. Quickly became a holy grail for me.
This product is one of my favorites. It can be combined with any skin care regimen or as a stand alone. I use it every day!

I have to admit, I wasn't sold on this product when I first tried it, but I'm enjoying it now. My skin is on the drier side in colder months, so when I tried this in cold weather, it wasn't enough for me and also didn't feel like it absorbed into my skin. Just felt a little tacky and like it was sitting on top of my skin. Fast forward to summer and this has become my daily moisturizer. Where I live, it's humid in summer and my skin isn't quite so dry. I've been applying a little less product than at first, which helps it absorb better and not feel so tacky. If you have normal or oily skin, I'd say this could be a good product to try. If you tend to be more dry, it might not be for you.

avis.titre: Absolutely love the way this feels on my skin
avis.texte: Absolutely love the way this feels on my skin. It's a great hydration to use under my sunscreen.

I do really like this product. It feels really nice going on and hydrating but after a little while it seems like my face feels a little greasy and I not sure if that is the case or if I am just that hydrated lol. I wish they had mini samples that people could try before buying the big jar :/ if you have an oily t zone, this may not be the product for you.

This product has truly transformed my skin— I have textured skin with a combination of normal to oily (in my t-zone), and it works great with maintaining my moisture barrier! My skin has become so soft since using, even my boyfriend noticed (he notices nothing ever🤣) Buy it!!
I would recommend this product to those with dry skin. I dont believe i'm the ideal user for this as my skin is more oily and it left me a little sticky.
I wanted to love this product although I think a tube would have been better. Beside that part, the problem is the breakouts it caused!!!
I liked it at first, but now it feels like I'm rubbing glue all over my face. I missed the return window by 2 days unfortunately before I realized I could return it. Oh well - live and learn.
Absolutely in love! I layer this over the hyaluronic acid serum for intense but lightweight moisture that keeps my skin looking bouncy and hydrated. Obsessed!

I love first aid beauty and I took a chance on their new dewy gel moisturizer and I am obsessed. My skin looks so luminous and glowy with and without makeup! I wish they made a bigger size because I literally ran out of it in a month. My skin is hydrated and I especially love that it doesnt irritate my sensitive skin. 10/10
It feels nice on the skin, but it makes my front hair pieces SO greasy. There are other gel-cream moisturizers that do the same job and don't leave my hair greasy when it touches my face.

This moisturizer is amazing! I have very oily skin normally, but I was getting dry patches. I needed something light that worked and wouldn't cause breakouts. This on my skin was everything and more! I actually use it every night now!

avis.titre: I would recommend this to anyone.  Just try it!
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer! It leaves your skin soft and feeling clean. I use this with the cleanser and pads twice a day and I love it. I have sensitive skin and I don't have any kind of reaction. It's hot where I live so it doesn't feel sticky or greasy.

This product is nice. Its smooth consistency makes it easy to spread. Its a little too light for a night cream for me since my skin is dry but it works so well in the morning and sits nicely under my makeup.
I love this product doesn't leave face oily at all. Perfect for oily skin or combination skin. I use it with the first beauty face wash everyday.

I'm 37 with reactive combination skin that leans dry. I also have seborrheic dermatitis. That said, for YEARS I have tried to find a moisturizer that doesn't make my skin irritated, or cause breakouts or flare-ups. I've spent hundreds of dollars over my lifetime in pursuit of something works. This one is absolutely PERFECT. It's lightweight, hydrating, and absorbs into the skin quickly. Seriously, it's like a drink of water. If I'm feeling a little dry after using actives, I add a little of the ilia base face Milk, and they play so well together. Thank you, FAB, for giving me hope that there is actually a moisturizer that works for my skin.
I have been looking for something to replace the coconut water cream, which is my absolute favorite moisturizer. I really wanted to love this product. Unfortunately it made my face breakout!

avis.titre: Finally, the perfect combo skin moisturizer
avis.texte: I have been looking forever for a moisturizer that is not too light, not too heavy, not too goopy and not sticky for my combo to dry skin. This is it. Sinks in quickly, does not pill, does not feel sticky or tacky, does not feel too heavy. Just lovely, soft skin. Layers great over my other skincare and under my foundation as well.

avis.titre: The one gel lotion/cream you need
avis.texte: I bought this a week ago and noticed a HUGE difference overnight after the very first night I used it. My skin feels plump and nourished, not dry and tight, but not oily either (T-zone). Balanced, really. The gel formulation is lightweight but substantial. No heavy scent either. I stopped using any other stuff on my face but I top this with the new dimethicone barrier cream. It's a powerful combination. My skin is combination, pimple prone at times, with blackheads on my nose. Everything looks smoother, pores smaller, no new pimples (which usually happens whenever I try a new skin product), plumper, more glowy too. I just use some pressed powder over and no makeup. After just a week, my skin looks better than it has in years. I'm in my 50s, so I've tried a lot of things! I love the blue jar too.

This stuff is like if Kiehl's ultra facial cream and Clinique moisture surge had a baby… but even better!!! I have dry/combo skin and I absolutely LOVE this for night and morning. It feels like a dream, hydrates well, absorbs quickly, and has zero scent. My new Holy grail product for sure. It's perfect under sunscreen and skin tint with no oiliness or pilling as well. First Aid Beauty knocks it out of the park once again.

I developed peri-oral dermatitis when I turned 30, my dermatologist said current prescription creams wouldn't work (althought I've found articles/blogs say clindamycin cream helps) but I could go on Doxicyclin, I really didn't want to add a medication with a lengthy list of side-effects. A few FAB products were mentioned consistently in the posts so I ordered the gentle cleanser and ultra repair cream - and they WORKED to reduce and sooth my redness and slight scalyness/bumps if used consistently. I do still have flare ups and a slight redness in the creases between my lips and cheeks. I saw this product came out so I added it before the Ultra Repair cream. IT IS AMAZING. On hotter days I'll use this as a moisturizer alone in the AM. It has been a brilliant addition to Facial Oil Cleanser, Oatmeal toner, and ultra repair cream! I wish it came in the giant tub. With daily and nightly use, it did last for 2 months, Sooo super worth it!!

I recently got this and i loveeee the dewy formula. I normally get the intense hydration cream, but I always wished they would make a much lighter formula, and it was perfect when they released this. I love it. Suitable for sensitive skin and great for oily, especially in this upcoming hot weather.
So hydrating!! Ive tried the colloid oatmeal moisturizer but this is 10x better!

I got to try the Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer from First Aid Beauty and I'm amazed! This cream is so cooling and soothing to my skin. After applying it, my face feels calmer, moisturized, and plump. Visually, my skin was radiant! No dry spots, a bouncy plumpness, and less redness. The ingredients are really nice for me. This would go best for oily skin types I believe. Personally, the ultra rich moisturizer suits my really dry skin better during the winter, but the formula of this gel cream is perfect for me for summer days when I am less dry and want a lighter formula. I love barrier support and this gives me that. Love it!

I recently got my hands on the First Aid Beauty Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer and I love how hydrating my skin feels after using! This sits very well under my makeup and I sometimes use it as a primer. This is great for all skin types, including people with sensitive skin. This did not irritate my skin at al!

avis.titre: How is this replacing the coconut water cream?!
avis.texte: Unfortunately, my favorite moisturizer that I've been using for years has been discontinued (the Coconut Water Cream Moisturizer), so I decided to try FAB's new moisturizer and it's awful (for me). I have very oily skin in the spring and summer, and normal skin with dry patches at times in the fall and winter. I also suffer from acne. When I read that this is supposed to be lightweight, breathable, and non-oily, I thought it would be a great replacement but I was incredibly wrong. It's heavy and extremely oily. I only used a dime-size amount for my entire face and neck but even that felt like way too much! It never fully absorbed into my skin and I cannot stand the feeling of a greasy product sitting on my face. This will most likely be perfect for those with super dry skin but this isn't the one for the oily fam! FAB, PLEASE BRING BACK THE COCONUT WATER CREAM!!! PLEASE!!! IT'S THE ONLY MOISTURIZER THAT HAS WORKED FOR ME FOR 6 YEARS!!! :(

I love this cream so much, I keep mine in my skin fridge and whenever I apply it gives me such a great hydrating cooling effect on my skin. Feels like I had 30glasses of water honestly so hydrating and plumping! And the formula also absorbs nicely and its not a sticky cream. I love it so much

I'm really enjoying this product so far. I usually use a lightweight moisturizer during the day and this one car exceeded my expectations. It's a nice creamy consistency but not too thick, it goes on so smoothly and my skin feels soft and not overly moisturized.
my skin love to get oily by the end of day which makes having a more natural look challenging but i love that this moisturizer leaves the perfect dewy look without getting oily

definitely one of my favorite morning moisturizers I've ever used! the extremely subtle scent is nice, but not overpowering whatsoever. the product glides on really nicely and I cant wait to see how long it lasts!

The First Aid Beauty Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream is a lightweight, oil-free moisturizer that provides hydration while keeping the skin feeling refreshed and balanced. Infused with hyaluronic acid, ceramides, squalane, and niacinamide, this gel-cream aims to boost moisture, strengthen the skin barrier, and promote a naturally dewy, plump complexion without clogging my pores or causing excess oil. As someone who enjoys gel-based moisturizers, I was excited to try this, and it did not disappoint. The texture is ultra-light and breathable, absorbing quickly into my skin without leaving behind any greasy residue. Overall, the First Aid Beauty Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream is an excellent choice for oily, combination, and normal skin types looking for a lightweight yet effective moisturizer.
Another winner from FAB! Light, but effective and doesn't irritate my rosacea prone skin! I highly recommend!

I have an acne/oily prone skin and this product made my pores smaller didnt break me put and did not make my face super oily how other moisturizer have done it leaves my my skin so soft and glass looking i love this product
Love that this works so good for my oily skin. It is super hydrating and it doesn't leave my skin more oily than it already is.

I love this cream so much! It is so nourishing and melts into my oily skin so well! Since I already get oily throughout the day, I prefer a lighter gel moisturizer that doesn't feel too think on my face for the daytime and this is it!
I would definitely purchase for a daily moisturizer! It keeps my skin refreshed without clogging my pores. Definitely recommend!
This lightweight gel cream is a glass skin in a jar. No kidding - it makes my skin look and feel hydrated, plumped and gives a nice, healthy glow.

This dewey hydration balm has been working wonders for my combo skin! Being that I live in Florida, I was on the hunt for hydration that wouldnt leave me feeling too oily for summer and this checks all the boxes!

The texture is so light and refreshing, perfect for everyday use, especially for combination skin like mine. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling hydrated without any greasiness or stickiness. I love it helps keep my skin smooth and glowing.

I really like this gel cream moisturizer because it is lightweight, gentle on my sensitive skin, and hydrating. The formula is not greasy and my skin has a natural, dewy finish upon application. This works well with my skincare and make-up products and I am happy with my results. My skin feels so soft when I apply this.

First aid beauty Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid + Ceramides is wonderful. It is very hydrating and leaves my skin so soft, smooth and younger looking. It is very gentle and I use it everyday. I highly recommend it to everybody.

This hydrating dew gel has worked wonders on my skin. It has now become a huge step in my skin care routine. I constantly struggle with dry skin even after using moisturizer but thanks to the cream my skin feels so soft and smooth.

This moisturizer is absolutely wonderful and hydrating. My skin tends to be on the drier side, but it still delivers enough moisture to keep it soft and nourished all day. It layers beautifully under makeup, leaving my skin with a gorgeous, dewy glow. Overall, it's a fantastic everyday cream! Gifted from FAB.

I have an oily t zone and skin that is more dry on my cheeks/neck. This formula is both lightweight and hydrating which is perfect for my skin year round. The product soaks in and keeps my face feeling relaxed all day. It works well with my face makeup too and I've found it even makes my foundation last longer. I love the refreshing feeling each time I put it on.

This moisturizes works great for my skin. It is hydrating without feeling heavy and doesn't cause any irritation. The texture is super lightweight and refreshing and the packaging is great too. Gifted by FAB.

The FAB Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream has an incredibly lightweight and silky texture. It feels refreshing, bouncy, and luxurious on the skin. It leaves my complexion deeply hydrated, plump, and glowing. It absorbs effortlessly, and the adorable baby blue jar is so charming. Gifted by FAB.

This is a fabulous gel cream moisturizer! It's keeping my face moisturized during these cold winter temps, which is impressive for a gel cream. The texture is soothing and hydrating while feeling lightweight on my skin. Ingredients wise, I love the niacinamide because it helps keep my sebaceous filaments in check, and my eczema appreciates the colloidal oatmeal.

This is a fabulous gel cream moisturizer! It's keeping my face moisturized during these cold winter temps, which is impressive for a gel cream. The texture is soothing and hydrating while feeling lightweight on my skin. Ingredients wise, I love the niacinamide because it helps keep my sebaceous filaments in check, and my eczema appreciates the colloidal oatmeal.

This moisturizer has very quickly become a must have for me! I tend to have dry skin especially during these cold, dry winter months and this has been a game changer! I love the texture of it and how it melts into my skin leaving it hydrated and soft. I highly recommend it!
This is so delightful! I absolutely love how lightweight this feels and patchy dry spots that would pop through my make up at the end of the day are gone! I'm obsessed.

I have been using this for a few weeks now and I adore this moisturizer. It is lightweight and applies easily to my skin without leaving my skin feeling greasy. I love that it does a great job at making my skin feel hydrated and smooth.
This moisturzier works wonderful, love that a little truly goes a long way and ot offers a deep hydration. This is perfect for my oily skin.
This moisturzier works wonderful, love that a little truly goes a long way and ot offers a deep hydration. This is perfect for my oily skin.

I typically refer gel moisturizers, even in the winter so this moisturizer worked great for me! It was a nice lightweight gel that seemed to absorb quickly without leaving a sticky feeling behind. My skin felted nourished and hydrated and had a nice subtle dewy finish. I really like that it's fragrance free too.

I love this cream! I have a combination type skin and this cream is just perfect for me. It is so lightweight and hydrating without making me feel more oily. It does well under makeup without any issues. I'm my skin definitely look better since I started using it! Highly recommend it! Gifted by FAB

I've been testing the new First Aid Beauty Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer, and it's a winner for lightweight hydration. The texture is a dreamy gel-cream hybrid that melts into the skin, leaving it feeling refreshed and bouncy. It gives an instant dewy glow without feeling greasy, making it perfect for morning use under makeup. The hydration lasts surprisingly well, keeping my skin plump throughout the day. If you love a fresh, weightless moisturizer that still packs a punch with moisture, this one's worth trying!

This moisturizer is so lightweight, yet so hydrating! With hyaluronic acid and ceramides, this cream provides 24 hour hydration! This has a cooling, water based gel texture that absorbs quickly, making it ideal for my combo skin! After using it consistently, my skin feels soft, smooth, and balanced. This is a fantastic option for anyone who wants deep hydration without the weight.

This Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer is so hydrating. I have dry maturing skin and this felt so good on my skin. Instantly hydrating and so soothing. This one has definitely made its way to my daily routine.

So I'm always on the hunt for a good moisturizer that won't break me out, and this one is amazing. It's got this really nice, light texture that feels so refreshing on my skin. It's not greasy at all, which is a huge plus, and it actually keeps my skin hydrated all day. My makeup goes on really smoothly over it too. I've noticed my skin looks brighter and healthier since I started using it.

This brand is amazing and this new mositurizer is sooo good. I have combination skin so its a bit hard sometimes to find a moisturizer that doesnt break me out but still hydrates my dry skin and this one does it perfectly! Leaves my skin quenched and glowing.

I am picky about thick sticky textures in skincare and so often really like to use gel or gel cream type moisturizers. This is a terrific new option with A+ cosmetic elegance and really nice packaging. The hyaluronic acid is a great addition for boosting its hydrating properties.
This moisterizer is great for sensitive acne prone skin. My skin has been glowing since i started using this product!

This cream-gel moisturizer is a must for my combo-dry skin type! It's a powerhouse in hydration. My skin is well hydrated throughout the entire day and night. This moisturizer is weightless, unscented and oil-free. It layers really well underneath my sunscreen and foundation. When worn alone or with just sunscreen on top, it has an healthy,dewy finish. I received this from First Aid Beauty for my honest opinion, and I actually do love this moisturizer.

honestly this is such a good product. it's super hydrating and amazing for my fellow sensitive skin girlies! this has become a staple in my morning skincare routine and one of my new favorite products.

I love this moisturizer because it's super hydrating and great for my chapped cold weather skin. It's a clear gel-like serum, that leaves behind a slightly tacky residue. I love that it's unscented! Overall, it's a great simple moisturizer for hydration.
Live how this leaves my skin. Very gentle and smooth. I use this on a daily basis and has kept my skin from drying out and leaves a soft dewy healthy glow. Complimentary for review

This moisturizer has a fantastic texture. It's lightweight but hydrating and goes on smoothly. It absorbs quickly and leave my skin feeling moisturized and soft. I have combo skin and it works great for keep my skin hydrated the whole day without any dry spots.
This is such a great moisturizer. It goes on so smooth and leaves my skin feeling very soft.

The texture is so light and bouncy. It sinks in instantly, leaving a dewy, plump finish without any greasiness. Hydration lasts all day, and the formula is soothing, with no irritation, just soft, healthy-looking skin. Layers beautifully under my makeup and sunscreen without pilling. Love how it gives that fresh, well-moisturized glow without feeling heavy!

This Moisturizer has been used daily in my skin care routine. It keeps my skin feeling really hydrated while boosting the glowing appearance of my skin without leaving my skin, feeling heavy, oily or greasy. It has worked wonders in these cold months, where my skin tends to get more dry easily.
LOVE the consistency of this! It has been my everyday morning moisturizer. It is truly jelly yet blends super well and feels very hydrating. it is not greasy and it feels great all day.

Quench your skin's thirst with the hydrating dewy gel cream moisturizer! I have combination skin with oily+dry patches but found this to work well through out my face. It's also winter time here so my skin has been going through it with the harsh winds and cold temperatures. I use this cream twice a day in my skin care routine. There is no strong fragrance. The gel cream glides on easily and absorbs effortlessly. I also love that its such a large tub of product, it'll last me quite awhile.
I absolutely love how hydrating and dewy this left my skin! It sat beautifully under makeup as well, which is something that I always look for!

Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid + Ceramides Review ⭐ Rating: 4.9/5 The Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer is a powerhouse for hydration, delivering a fresh, dewy glow while strengthening the skin's barrier. Infused with hyaluronic acid and ceramides, this lightweight gel-cream formula deeply nourishes, plumps, and locks in moisture without feeling greasy. It absorbs quickly, making it ideal for both morning and night routines. Leaves skin looking dewy, plump, and glowing. Ceramides help reinforce the skin barrier. Perfect under makeup or as a nighttime moisturizer. If you're searching for a hydrating, skin-plumping moisturizer that delivers long-lasting moisture while giving you a fresh, healthy glow, this gel-cream is a must-try.
